description: AFOXIE crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C81 H54 N9 O9 Y3,C4 H10 O2. From the CIF bond table, Y1 (Y) has 7 O neighbors; Y2 (Y) has 4 O neighbors; Y3 (Y) has 4 O neighbors. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.496-3.500 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 93.17-98.42°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links.
